title: Rosie Disposition | Beautiful Pet Friendly Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Rosie Disposition is a pet-friendly 30A retreat near Alys and Rosemary Beach, featuring bikes, bunks, designer interiors, and a community pool.
description_expanded: Rosie Disposition Designer Retreat Near 30A Favorites with Bikes and Pool Access Home Introduction Unwind in style at Rosie Disposition , a spacious 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath retreat in the gated Treetops of Seacrest community. With designer interiors, room for up to 16 guests, and easy access to beaches, dining, and shopping, this home is the perfect 30A getaway for families and groups . Home Highlights · Community Pool - Located across the street, shared with only a few homes (not heated) · 5 Taxi Bikes - Professionally serviced and ready to ride · Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, with approval and fee required · Sleeping for 16 Guests - 3 King suites plus large bunk room · Incredible Bunk Room - Custom bunks sleeping up to 8 · Gourmet Kitchen - Stainless KitchenAid appliances, pantry, and polished countertops · Spacious Living Area - Wood beam ceiling with plush sectional seating · Dining Space - Seating for 6 plus breakfast bar for 4 · Outdoor Living - Covered front porch and back patio with seating · Outdoor Shower - Perfect after beach days · Gas Grill - Ideal for outdoor meals · Smart TV and WIFI - Entertainment in the main living area · 2nd Floor Laundry - High efficiency washer and dryer · Driveway Parking - Accommodates 2 vehicles · Designer Interiors - Thoughtfully curated throughout the home Location Perks · 5 minute drive to Inlet Beach public access with parking and restrooms · 3 minute bike ride to Alys Beach for shopping, dining, and playground · 4 minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach with dining and scenic architecture · 4 minute drive to Publix for groceries and curbside pickup Know Before You Go · Mid-stay clean required for reservations of 10 days or longer, included in your stay · Concierge services available for grocery delivery, bike rentals, beach bonfires, baby equipment, and more · Tram service to Seacrest Beach runs March 1 through October 31 from 10 AM to 5 PM · Golf carts are not permitted in Seacrest Beach, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, or along Highway 98 Enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, style, and location at Rosie Disposition, where your entire group, including your pup, can experience the best of 30A together. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | Sleeps 4 total in a king bed plus twin over twin bunk. TV, small private balcony, dresser storage, ensuite bath with vanity sink and walk in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, Closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with quartz top vanity sink and walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Suite 3 | Smart TV, walk-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with vanity sink and combination shower/tub
3rd Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 8 in Twin over Twin Bunks. Large TV, kids table with seating, closet storage, hallway access to full bath with vanity sink and combination shower/tub

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
